description: Permissions for the embedded browser-preview webviews created by browser_open. These are child Webviews attached to the main window (so `windows` targets "main") with labels like `browser-<sessionId>` (so `webviews` filters down to those specific surfaces). The injected inspector — which runs on whatever third-party page the user pointed at — is allowed exactly one Tauri command: `browser_preview_emit`, which only forwards namespaced `browser-preview://*` events. The relay validates the event prefix on the Rust side, so a hostile page can't escalate beyond posting events into the main window.
